summary: LogProstyle Inc., a Japanese operative builder, filed a Form 6-K reporting that director and executive officer Katharyn Field resigned on August 18, 2026, with no disagreement disclosed. The filing is the sole event; no operational or strategic change is indicated. As a foreign private issuer, the Form 6-K serves as the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K Item 5.02. The resignation appears voluntary and non-confrontational, though abrupt for a board member. What to watch: whether successors are named and any further disclosures on board composition or strategic direction.
